scope: Undamaged standalone full-target gravity fixture; engineering numerical checks, not experimental validation
provenance: Frozen before first ledger run. Absolute impulse budget is about 0.08% of one second of total target weight; angular budget uses a 0.1 m characteristic length. Energy bound is an added numerical injection stop, not physical material accuracy. Original volume, board and settling gates remain unchanged.
limitations: No actuator, robot, fracture or moving-support work in this fixture. Fixed support work is zero only after the exact fixed-position check passes. Record numerical dissipation; do not present loss of energy alone as a full work qualification.
